responsibility: This header defines the prefix_list and path_prefix data structures and declares the file-search helpers implemented in file-find.cc. It provides the interface for building ordered search-prefix lists, populating them from environment strings, enabling debug tracing, and resolving filenames against those prefixes for GCC tool and resource discovery.
same_name_distinction: Declares the file-location API and the prefix_list/path_prefix data structures shared with callers. The paired source file contains the actual search logic, debug tracing, and prefix parsing routines.
